name: Elemental Hands
body:
School evocation [air, Earth, Fire, or water]; Level: earth lord 1, storm knight 1, winter warlock 1

Components: V, S

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 15 ft.

Area: Cone-shaped burst

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell is identical to burning hands, but produces a fan of electricity (air), magma (earth) fire (fire) or ice (water), depending on the caster’s elemental specialty. Storm knights may use either electricity or ice, and earth lords use magma. winter warlocks use ice. Fire and magma can cause flammable materials to burn similar to burning hands, and electricity and ice cause those who fail to save to suffer –1 to attack rolls and skill checks for 1 round.
